<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs from src/data/openapi.json: do not edit, run `task refs`. -->

- `GET /api/v1/auth/me/ways-in` — The signed-in account's email and linked provider accounts
- `POST /api/v1/auth/me/email` — Link an email, proved by the code sent to it (replaces the one there was)
- `DELETE /api/v1/auth/me/email` — Unlink the email
- `POST /api/v1/auth/me/accounts/{provider}/start` — Begin linking a provider account: where to send the browser
- `POST /api/v1/auth/me/accounts/{provider}/callback` — Finish linking a provider account
- `DELETE /api/v1/auth/me/accounts/{account_id}` — Unlink a provider account
- `POST /api/v1/auth/me/move` — Leave this empty account for the one a way in belongs to, and sign in there
- `GET /api/v1/auth/me/tokens` — The account's API tokens, newest first (never their secrets)
- `POST /api/v1/auth/me/tokens` — Make an API token (from a sign-in only); its secret is shown this once
- `DELETE /api/v1/auth/me/tokens/{token_id}` — Revoke an API token

## The signed-in account's email and linked provider accounts

`GET /api/v1/auth/me/ways-in` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [WaysIn](/reference/api/schemas/#waysin) |

## Link an email, proved by the code sent to it (replaces the one there was)

`POST /api/v1/auth/me/email` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

**Body** (`application/json`): [EmailLink](/reference/api/schemas/#emaillink)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) |  |
| `code` | string | pattern `^\d{6}$` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [LinkResult](/reference/api/schemas/#linkresult) |
| 401 | [`invalid_code`](/reference/errors/#invalid_code): wrong or expired |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 429 | [`too_many_attempts`](/reference/errors/#too_many_attempts): this code, or the address for a while (`Retry-After`); [`too_many_requests`](/reference/errors/#too_many_requests): the network address |

## Unlink the email

`DELETE /api/v1/auth/me/email` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 204 | — |
| 409 | [`last_way_in`](/reference/errors/#last_way_in) |

## Begin linking a provider account: where to send the browser

`POST /api/v1/auth/me/accounts/{provider}/start` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [OAuthStart](/reference/api/schemas/#oauthstart) |
| 404 | [`unknown_provider`](/reference/errors/#unknown_provider) |
| 409 | [`provider_disabled`](/reference/errors/#provider_disabled): not configured |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## Finish linking a provider account

`POST /api/v1/auth/me/accounts/{provider}/callback` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [OAuthCallback](/reference/api/schemas/#oauthcallback)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | min length 1, max length 2048 |
| `state` | string | min length 1, max length 256 |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [LinkResult](/reference/api/schemas/#linkresult) |
| 400 | [`invalid_state`](/reference/errors/#invalid_state): unknown, used, expired or another account's |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 502 | [`provider_error`](/reference/errors/#provider_error) |

## Leave this empty account for the one a way in belongs to, and sign in there

`POST /api/v1/auth/me/move` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

**Body** (`application/json`): [MoveIn](/reference/api/schemas/#movein)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticket` | string | min length 1, max length 256 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [SignedIn](/reference/api/schemas/#signedin) |
| 400 | [`invalid_ticket`](/reference/errors/#invalid_ticket): unknown, used or expired |
| 409 | [`not_empty`](/reference/errors/#not_empty): it holds something now |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## Make an API token (from a sign-in only); its secret is shown this once

`POST /api/v1/auth/me/tokens` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

**Body** (`application/json`): [TokenIn](/reference/api/schemas/#tokenin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | max length 100 |
| `expires_in_days` *(optional)* | integer | ≥ 1, ≤ 365, default `90` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | [TokenMade](/reference/api/schemas/#tokenmade) |
| 403 | [`sign_in_required`](/reference/errors/#sign_in_required): a token cannot make one |
| 409 | [`too_many_tokens`](/reference/errors/#too_many_tokens) |
| 422 | [`name_required`](/reference/errors/#name_required) |
